wines.intro: A rich, botrytized first-growth Sauternes with tropical fruit, intense golden color and a balancing line of freshness.
wines.nose: Lychee, ripe mango, pineapple, candied peach and ginger.
wines.palate: Opulent yellow fruit, candied apricot and a taut acid backbone.
wines.aeration: Chill, not ice-cold. Older vintages may benefit from gentle aeration.
